requirements_summary.summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via an interactive map or Telegram bot. Reports undergo a lifecycle from submission and approval by a Public Relations Officer to assignment, resolution by technical offices or external maintainers, and public visibility. The system supports anonymity, multi-role municipal staff, external maintainer integration, real-time notifications (email/Telegram/platform), and detailed statistics for administrators.

requirements.text:
As an unregistered user
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to assign roles to municipality users
constraints: Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer. You can be more specific on technical offices to run realisti scenarios following the official organizational structure of the municipality of Turin (https://trasparenza.comune.torino.it/media/2212/download)

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
constraints: Map should be zoomable. When zooming out, reports can be grouped into a cumulative report for a better visualization (total number should be reported on the cumulative report). When zooming in,  reports can be seen separated, with their title and reporter name (or "anonymous" if this is flagged on that report).
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to modify roles to municipality users
So that the staff can be more flexible.
constraints: This story overwrites a previous answer given by PO on the Telegram chat. NB: 1) A municipality user can now have multiple roles, i.e. serving on more than one technical office. 2) Modification includes cancellation.
expected_behaviors: the staff can be more flexible

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform 
So that I can communicate directly about my report.
constraints: Two-way communication is possible within the platform.
expected_behaviors: I can communicate directly about my report

requirements.text:
As a municipal administrator
I want to configure automatic assignment of all reports in a certain category
So that interventions will be faster.

domain_rules: Reports must be in 'Pending Approval' state until the Organization Office performs preliminary verification.
Accepted reports move to 'Assigned' state and are sent to the competent technical office depending on the problem category.
Rejected reports require a mandatory explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Once submitted, a report cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
Anonymous user's name is visible to staff but hidden in the public map view for citizens.
Only technical office staff members can have multiple roles.
External maintainers are added by the system administrator and must have their own individual account.
Communication between technical office and external maintainer (Case 1) is report-specific and reserved (not visible to reporter).
Automatic assignment of all issues of a certain category is possible only if previously set by the municipal administrator.
Email is a mandatory field for registration and can be used for login.
Public statistics are visible to unregistered users; private statistics are restricted to administrators.
edge_cases: External maintainer resolves a report without direct access (Case 2): Technical office staff member updates status to 'Resolved'.
Zooming out on the map groups reports into a cumulative view showing total number.
Downloading CSV with active filters only exports the filtered subset of data.
Following a report: Only not closed reports can be followed; notifications follow same rules as owned reports.
Telegram bot commands (/help, /contact, /faq) provide system usage info and useful contacts.
Status change triggers both platform notification and email (unless disabled in config).
Internal comments exchanged between staff and external maintainers are not visible to the reporter or citizens.
assumptions: The 'Organization Office' refers to a specific administrative unit within the Municipality of Turin responsible for initial review.
Competent technical office is determined by the problem category (e.g., Public Lighting -> Enel X or specific office).
Telegram bot integration requires users to have provided their Telegram username in the configuration panel.
Real-time push notifications via Telegram depend on the user having subscribed (/subscribe) and having a valid Telegram session.
The 'top 1% of reporters' statistic implies a ranking mechanism based on report volume or engagement metrics defined by the administrator.
Case 2 (external company without access) implies the technical office staff member manually updates the status to 'Resolved' after receiving confirmation from the external company outside the system.

risks: registerCitizen does not automatically create an authenticated session; clients must call getCurrentSession after registration to access protected endpoints.
deleteCurrentSession invalidates the session token, breaking all subsequent auth-required calls until a new login occurs.
listApprovedReports is public (no auth), but other report endpoints require authentication; inconsistent access control may lead to unauthorized data exposure if not enforced at gateway level.
Admin endpoints (listOperatorsForAdmin, createMunicipalityUser) assume admin-level authorization within the session; documentation does not specify how admin roles are validated.
Route name 'mainteiner' is a typo in the backend; clients must handle this spelling inconsistency to avoid 404 errors.
Verification token expiry (getCitizenVerificationToken) may expire before verifyCitizenEmail is called, leading to 423 conflicts if not handled by client logic.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Unregistered user can view approved reports on an interactive map.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports/approved without any authentication headers. Verify that the response returns a list of approved reports suitable for display on a map, ensuring anonymous user names are hidden and public statistics are visible.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core public-facing functionality for unregistered users as per domain rules regarding public map view.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
strategy_items.prompt: First, create a new report via POST /reports using an authenticated technical office staff session. Then, execute PUT /reports/{id}/mainteiner to assign an external maintainer ID to the created report. Verify the assignment is successful and the report state updates correctly.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create a new report via POST /reports to obtain a valid report ID for assignment.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the created report using DELETE /reports/{id} if it was successfully created; otherwise, verify no resource exists.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the specific workflow of assigning external maintainers to reports, a critical step in the intervention process.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member updates report statuses.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as a technical office staff member. Execute PUT /reports/{id}/status to transition a report from 'Pending Approval' to 'Assigned'. Verify the state change and that the correct technical office is assigned based on the problem category.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create a new report via POST /reports to obtain a valid report ID for status update.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the created report using DELETE /reports/{id} if it was successfully created; otherwise, verify no resource exists.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the transition from pending to assigned state, ensuring the system correctly routes reports to technical offices.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Municipal administrator configures automatic assignment of all reports in a certain category.
strategy_items.prompt: Authenticate as a municipal administrator. Execute POST /reports/{id}/auto-assign-maintainer to configure automatic assignment for a specific report category. Verify that the configuration is saved and applies to future reports of that category.
setup_needed: Ensure no existing auto-assignment rules conflict with the new configuration for the target category.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the administrative capability to configure automatic assignment rules, ensuring faster interventions as per requirements.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username to access the system.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a happy path registration for a citizen. Provide a unique username, valid email, and password. Verify that the response indicates successful registration and returns a verification code or token as expected by domain rules.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the primary entry point for citizen access (PT01) and ensures the system generates necessary verification artifacts.
